newsitem.title: INDIA: India I-Sec's debt market portfolio watch list.
newsitem.headline: India I-Sec's debt market portfolio watch list.

text.p: ICICI Securities and Finance Company (I-Sec) said it placed the following securities in its "portfolio watch" representing stocks that are likely to outperform the market.
Security Residual Modified Net Price Yield Weightage

The recommended portfolio is weighted heavily in favour of 12.59 percent 2004 and 11.83 percent 2003. The newly issued 11.19 percent 2005 security is trading at 11.12 percent, barely 2 basis points higher than the 12.59 percent 2004 which is 14 months shorter in maturity.
The modified duration of 12.59 percent 2004 is 4.5238 much lower than that of 11.19 percent 2005 which is 5.1975.

To justify the maturity and duration differential between these securities, the yield difference between them is expected to widen and the 12.59 percent stock is expected to appreciate over the next fortnight. The same reasoning holds good in favour of 11.83 percent 2003 as well.
